blocks.text: 今天，HumanLayer 正式加入 Factory，共同加速为企业与开发者打造自主、可自我改进的软件。我们一直很欣赏 Dex Horthy 和 Kyle Mistele，也很高兴能一起构建软件工厂的未来。

blocks.text: Dex 和 Kyle 从 2025 年初起就是编程智能体的重度用户，早期就提出了智能体集群等想法，并在 2025 年 8 月发布了 Research/Plan/Implement 框架——最早一批走红的“技能包”之一。此后，HumanLayer 在编程智能体与软件工厂的最佳实践上，长期领先行业风向 6 到 9 个月，对拥有数百乃至数千名工程师的大型团队尤其如此。他们的文章和演讲累计获得数百万次浏览，产品也赢得了一批忠实用户。

blocks.text: 在与 Dex 和 Kyle 的交流中，我们清楚地看到，两支团队在使命、对彼此贡献的尊重，以及一个我们能够更快更好共同实现的愿景上高度一致。我们决定联手，是因为相信这对 Factory 和 HumanLayer 的客户都是重大利好；目前我们已经在一起开发，服务于我们的开发者和企业用户。

blocks.text: 接下来，我们会将 HumanLayer 开源，并邀请所有 HumanLayer 用户加入 Factory。Dex 和 Kyle 打造了一款出色的产品，也凝聚了一个忠实的开发者社区，日活跃用户达数百人，我们希望在过渡期间为他们提供支持。

inlines.text: 接下来，我们会将 HumanLayer 开源，并邀请所有 HumanLayer 用户加入 Factory。Dex 和 Kyle 打造了一款出色的产品，也凝聚了一个忠实的开发者社区，日活跃用户达数百人，我们希望在过渡期间为他们提供支持。

blocks.text: 在过渡期内，现有的 HumanLayer 平台将继续正常运行，我们会支持用户完成以下任意或全部事项：导出数据、迁移到 Factory，或自行部署开源的 HumanLayer。

blocks.text: 作为此次收购的一部分，我们很高兴把 HumanLayer 一些最受喜爱的功能带到 Factory。未来几周，Dex、Kyle 和团队将全力推进多人任务/工作流，以及针对智能体撰写的计划、产品规格和设计文档的应用内协作等功能。我们期待分享后续进展，并尽早听取 HumanLayer 社区对这些工作的反馈。

关于 Factory

blocks.text: Factory 为企业带来自主软件工程能力。Factory 帮助企业运行一套受治理、与模型无关的系统，把业务优先级和工程信号转化为生产软件。Droids 会在每家公司的基础设施、策略和获批模型范围内规划、构建、验证并改进工作。每条工作流都会从可衡量的结果中学习，从而扩大工程产能、提升质量，并把工程与业务成果挂钩。Factory 由 Matan Grinberg 和 Eno Reyes 于 2023 年创立，总部位于旧金山。

blocks.text: Today, HumanLayer is joining Factory to accelerate building autonomous, self-improving software for enterprises and developers. We have long admired Dex Horthy and Kyle Mistele, and we are thrilled to be building the future of software factories together.

blocks.text: Dex and Kyle have been power users of coding agents since early 2025, early on ideas like agent swarms and publishing the Research/Plan/Implement framework, one of the first viral “skill packs” in August 2025. Since then, HumanLayer has been regularly 6-9 months ahead of the zeitgeist on best practices for working with coding agents and software factories, especially for larger teams with hundreds or thousands of engineers. Their writing and speaking has earned millions of views, and their product has earned a loyal following.

blocks.text: In conversations with Dex and Kyle, it became obvious that both teams were aligned on mission, respect for each other’s contributions, and a vision that we could pursue faster and better together. We joined forces knowing this would be a big win for customers of Factory and HumanLayer, and we are already building together in service of our developers and our enterprise users.

blocks.text: Going forward, we will be open sourcing HumanLayer and inviting all HumanLayer users to Factory. Dex and Kyle have created an impressive product and a devoted developer community with hundreds of daily active users, and we want to support them through the transition.

blocks.text: The current HumanLayer platform will remain up and running during a transition period, where we will support users in any or all of: exporting their data, migrating to Factory, or self-hosting the HumanLayer open source.

blocks.text: As part of this acquisition, we’re excited to bring some of the most beloved features of HumanLayer to Factory. In the next few weeks, Dex, Kyle and team are working hard to bring things like multiplayer tasks/workstreams and in-app collaboration on agent-written plans, product specs, and design docs. We’re excited to share what’s coming and get early feedback from the HumanLayer community on this work.

About Factory

blocks.text: Factory brings autonomous software engineering to the enterprise. Factory helps enterprises run a governed, model-independent system that turns business priorities and engineering signals into production software. Droids plan, build, validate, and improve work inside each company’s infrastructure, policies, and approved models. Every workstream learns from measured results, expanding engineering capacity, improving quality, and tying engineering to business results. Factory was founded in 2023 by Matan Grinberg and Eno Reyes and is headquartered in San Francisco.
